events.title: ECMAScript 2020 standardized
events.summary: Ecma adopted ECMAScript 2020 in June 2020 — adding optional chaining, nullish coalescing, `BigInt`, and `Promise.allSettled`.
events.about: ES2020 features became everyday JavaScript: `obj?.prop` and `value ?? fallback` reduced null-pointer bugs; `BigInt` handled large integers; dynamic `import()` improved code splitting. Every modern bundler and browser targets these additions.

narrative.whyChosen: ES2020 delivered some of the most-used syntax sugar in modern JavaScript.
narrative.whyImportant: Optional chaining and nullish coalescing changed how millions of developers handle missing data.
narrative.problemSolved: Accessing nested properties and defaulting null/undefined values required verbose, error-prone boilerplate.

events.title: OpenAI GPT-3 API announced
events.summary: OpenAI announced API access to GPT-3 on June 11, 2020 — opening large-language-model text generation to developers beyond research previews.
events.about: The GPT-3 API let apps call a 175B-parameter model for completion, summarization, and code generation via HTTP. It launched the LLM API economy — copywriting tools, coding assistants, and chatbots built on a single endpoint before ChatGPT's consumer interface.

narrative.whyChosen: The GPT-3 API was the commercial inflection point for LLMs in production software.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved developers would pay per token for generative AI at scale.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams could not ship LLM features without training and hosting their own massive models.
